name: voxengine-electron
description: Thin client over libengine.so (C backend is the source of truth)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main.js --platform=node --format=cjs --external:koffi --external:electron && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/preload.js --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron && esbuild src/renderer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer.js --platform=browser --format=iife && cp src/index.html dist/index.html
